# CivetWeb

Vendored from https://github.com/civetweb/civetweb, tag `v1.16`, commit
`d7ba35bbb649209c66e582d5a0244ba988a15159`. The original license and credits
are included alongside the unmodified public header and C implementation.

The z8-d test build enables WebSocket support and disables CGI and TLS. It is
intended for local integration; a TLS-capable production build is still needed.
